summary.note: This/these chỉ gần; that/those chỉ xa. This/that chỉ một, these/those chỉ nhiều.
summary.usage: This/these chỉ gần; that/those chỉ xa.

summary.note: Use “this/that is” for one thing and “these/those are” for more than one. “This/these” are near; “that/those” are farther away.
summary.example: The tables are far from me. Those are my tables.
